episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd coaches REALTOR David Farrell on overcoming personal and professional challenges to scale his business. They discuss the importance of aligning business activities with personal strengths and values, and the role of time management in achieving long-term goals. Michael emphasizes the need for authenticity and strategic focus in building a successful real estate career.
